title: Another chapter whereby air is given

verses.t: Another chapter whereby air is given.
I am the Jackal of jackals, I am Shu, who convey breezes, in presence of the Glorious one, to the ends of the sky, to the ends of the earth, to the ends of the filaments of Cloud.
I give air to those Younglings as I open my mouth and gaze with my two eyes.
